style: Neutral grayscale finished metal, four-rivet bevelled frame, silver inset ring, opaque charcoal plate and a narrow transparent exterior. Keep the complete part inside the ring with visible clearance.

blade_1_hollow_blade.subject: Slim tapered blade with a single long round-ended through-slot. The backplate shows through the slot.

blade_1_executioner_blade.subject: Wide-rooted blade with a shallow solid fuller and an angular pointed tip.

pommel_ring_chain_pommel.subject: Stepped metal cap, large steel ring and seven alternating interlocking links, including the terminal link.

pommel_fishtail_pommel.subject: Compact flared steel fan with a narrow collar, shallow central ridge and gently convex lower edge.

guard_raven_quill_guard.subject: Three swept, separately tipped steel vanes on each wing, with a chased feather on the central shield and a short collar.
